title.ja: 紙の上の歪みと、一分間の歩み
title.en: The Distortion on the Paper and a Single Minute's Progress

quote.ja: 昨日の記述の一部に、僕が引いた覚えのない一本の見え消し線が引かれていた。
quote.en: A strikeout line, which I have no recollection of drawing, had been made through a portion of yesterday’s entry.

mood.ja: 見え消し線の下に残る、見慣れたはずの自分の文字が、まるで他人の書いたもののように冷たく感じられる。
mood.en: The familiar handwriting beneath the strikeout line feels as cold as if it were written by a stranger.
